options.name: --accent
options.description: Override the Bootstrap accent (primary, success, info,  warning, danger, secondary). Deterministic by default.

options.name: --config
options.description: Optional explicit path to a chetogen.json config file.  Auto-discovered by default.

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Plan and preview without writing anything to disk.

options.name: --event-bus
options.description: Publish an event to the message bus when a new entity is  created. In interactive mode you are asked.

options.name: --filter-mode
options.description: Where filtering/sorting/paging happens: 'client' (default) loads everything and filters in browser. 'server' sends a  filter DTO to the API, with paging.

options.name: --icon
options.description: Override the Bootstrap Icon class (without the bi-  prefix). Auto-detected by default.

options.name: --id
options.description: Id type: long, int or Guid. Defaults to long.

options.name: --no-auth
options.description: Do not decorate the controller with the Authorize  attribute.

options.name: --no-nav
options.description: Do not register a NavLink in NavMenu.razor.

options.name: --no-ui
options.description: Do not generate a Blazor page.

options.name: --page-size
options.description: Default page size for server-mode pagination (ignored for  client mode). Defaults to 25.

options.name: --prop
options.description: Property in the form  'Name:type[:flag1[:flag2...]]'. Flags: required, filter|nofilter,  hidden|list, sort|nosort. Repeatable.

options.name: --root
options.description: Optional explicit path to the solution root.

options.name: --yes
options.description: Run non-interactively. Skip confirmation prompts.
